$comment: Prompts for tools/generate-sfx.mjs (ElevenLabs Sound Effects). Each kind has a length in seconds (20 credits a second) and may set how closely the sound follows the prompt (influence, 0–1, 0.5 when left out); an approved draft goes to src/client/audio/sfx/<id>.mp3 and into data/sounds.json.

prompts.wolf-hurt: a wolf yelps in pain from a hit, single short yelp, close up, dry, no music
prompts.wolf-death: a wolf whimpers and collapses, dying whine, close up, dry, no music
prompts.alpha-wolf-hurt: a huge wolf yelps and snarls in pain from a hit, sharp and loud, mid-pitched, close up, dry, no music
prompts.alpha-wolf-death: a huge wolf lets out a long dying howl that fades, close up, dry, no music
prompts.fox-hurt: a fox gives a sharp high yelp of pain, close up, dry, no music
prompts.fox-death: a fox whimpers weakly and falls silent, close up, dry, no music
prompts.lynx-hurt: a lynx hisses and snarls in pain from a hit, close up, dry, no music
prompts.lynx-death: a big wild cat gives a dying growl, close up, dry, no music
prompts.bear-hurt: a brown bear roars in pain from a hit, short deep roar, close up, dry, no music
prompts.bear-death: a brown bear groans deeply and collapses heavily, close up, dry, no music
prompts.boar-hurt: a wild boar squeals in pain from a hit, short, close up, dry, no music
prompts.boar-death: a wild boar grunts and squeals weakly as it dies, close up, dry, no music
prompts.badger-hurt: a badger hisses and chatters angrily from a hit, close up, dry, no music
prompts.badger-death: a badger gives a weak dying hiss, close up, dry, no music
prompts.crow-hurt: a raven gives a harsh croak of pain and flaps its wings, close up, dry, no music
prompts.crow-death: a raven croaks weakly and falls with a flutter of feathers, close up, dry, no music
prompts.owl-hurt: an owl screeches in pain from a hit, short, close up, dry, no music
prompts.owl-death: an owl gives a fading screech and falls with a flutter, close up, dry, no music
prompts.viper-hurt: a snake hisses sharply in pain, short, close up, dry, no music
prompts.viper-death: a snake gives a long fading hiss, close up, dry, no music
prompts.spider-hurt: a giant spider chitters and hisses from a hit, short, close up, dry, no music
prompts.spider-death: a giant spider screeches and its legs click as it curls up, close up, dry, no music
prompts.wisp-hurt: a ghostly flame spirit lets out a short high eerie whispering wail, airy and hissing, close up, no music
prompts.wisp-death: a ghostly flame spirit fades away with a high airy whispering sigh and a soft fizzle, close up, no music
prompts.likho-hurt: a gaunt forest demon shrieks in pain, raspy and inhuman, short, close up, dry, no music
prompts.likho-death: a gaunt forest demon lets out a long rattling death shriek, close up, dry, no music
prompts.male-hurt: a young man grunts in pain from a blow in a fight, short, no words, close up, dry, no music
prompts.male-death: a young man groans and falls to the ground exhausted, no words, close up, dry, no music
prompts.female-hurt: a young woman grunts in pain from a blow in a fight, short, no words, close up, dry, no music
prompts.female-death: a young woman groans and falls to the ground exhausted, no words, close up, dry, no music

prompts.swing: a quick whoosh of a sword swung through the air, single swing, dry, no music
prompts.bow: a crisp wooden bow string twang as an arrow is released, sharp and bright, single shot, close up, dry, no music
prompts.magic: a short crackling magic spark spell, a bright fizzing whoosh with a sparkle, fantasy, close up, no music
prompts.holy: a short bright holy magic chime with a shimmering burst, fantasy, no music
prompts.victory: a short triumphant fantasy horn fanfare, no drums
prompts.defeat: a short low mournful fantasy horn note fading out, no drums

prompts.tab-wood: a single soft click of a small wooden toggle switch, warm and muted, very short, close up, dry, no reverb, no music
prompts.tab-bead: a single small wooden bead tapping a wooden table once, soft and warm, very short, close up, dry, no reverb, no music
prompts.tab-pebble: two small smooth pebbles touching once, a soft gentle click, very short, close up, dry, no reverb, no music
prompts.tab-book: a single soft tap of a fingertip on a hardcover book, warm and muted, very short, close up, dry, no reverb, no music
prompts.tab-glass: a tiny soft muted glass tick, gentle and warm, a quiet user interface click, very short, no reverb, no music
